financial_metric.definition: CHECK ((((derivation = 'REPORTED'::text) AND (metric <> ALL (ARRAY['bps'::text, 'bps_total_shares'::text])) AND (NOT ((fiscal_period = 'Q4'::text) AND (period_kind = 'QUARTER'::text)))) OR ((derivation = 'FY_MINUS_9M'::text) AND (fiscal_period = 'Q4'::text) AND (period_kind = 'QUARTER'::text) AND (formula IS NOT NULL)) OR ((derivation = 'EQUITY_OVER_SHARES'::text) AND (metric = ANY (ARRAY['bps'::text, 'bps_total_shares'::text])) AND (formula IS NOT NULL))))

financial_metric.name: ck_financial_metric_period_end
financial_metric.definition:
CHECK ((period_end =
CASE fiscal_period
    WHEN 'Q1'::text THEN make_date((fiscal_year)::integer, 3, 31)
    WHEN 'Q2'::text THEN make_date((fiscal_year)::integer, 6, 30)
    WHEN 'Q3'::text THEN make_date((fiscal_year)::integer, 9, 30)
    ELSE make_date((fiscal_year)::integer, 12, 31)
